notes.title: Street Sense Update – 17 New Scenarios Added!
notes.notes:
Get ready to put your driving skills to the test! We’ve just added 17 brand-new scenarios to Street Sense, giving you even more opportunities to sharpen your hazard perception and decision-making on the road.

Whether you're a new driver learning the basics or an experienced one looking to improve, these new scenarios will challenge you with realistic road situations to enhance your driving awareness.

Update your game now and see if you have what it takes to master the latest challenges!
